name: io.github.SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_ENDPOINT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Endpoint URL of the custodial SAIHM operator you run or subscribe to. Not the hosted service at https://saihm.coti.global, which is non-custodial: use @saihm/mcp-server-pro for that.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_AUTH_HEADER
